Redragon GS560 Adiemus Dynamic RGB Desktop Gaming Soundbar

 The Redragon GS560 Adiemus Dynamic RGB Desktop Gaming Soundbar is an exceptionally stylish audio solution designed to bring rich stereo sound, vibrant visual flair, and space-saving utility to modern gaming setups and desktop battle stations. Powered by fine-tuned dual audio drivers and a passive bass radiator, the GS560 Adiemus delivers crisp highs, balanced mid-range vocals, and punchy acoustic depth, making it the perfect upgrade for gaming, music playback, and movie streaming without taking up valuable desk real estate.

 Meticulously engineered to fit seamlessly beneath your gaming monitor or desktop display, the Redragon GS560 Adiemus combines a sleek compact footprint with dynamic atmospheric lighting. Featuring touch-controlled RGB backlight modes that can pulse dynamically to your audio, a convenient front-facing volume knob, and universal plug-and-play USB power with a 3.5mm AUX interface, this desktop soundbar brings rich sound fidelity and captivating aesthetics straight to your PC setup.

 
 
 
 
 Compact Under-Monitor Soundbar Design

 Space-Saving Form Factor Engineered for Clean Desktop Layouts

 Say goodbye to bulky, traditional dual-speaker setups that clutter your desk pad. The Redragon GS560 Adiemus features a low-profile horizontal soundbar framework designed specifically to slide neatly under your PC monitor, television, or laptop riser. This space-saving layout keeps your desktop organized and clean while directing audio straight toward your seating position for optimal acoustic delivery.

 Its modern angled chassis and durable outer grille protect the internal drivers from dust and physical impact, providing a premium aesthetic that pairs naturally with contemporary gaming monitors, keyboards, and PC hardware accessories.

 
 Touch-Controlled Dynamic RGB Backlighting

 Multiple Lighting Modes with Audio Sync Visual Effects

 Transform your gaming room’s ambiance with the integrated, highly responsive RGB Chroma lighting system running along the front and base of the soundbar. Equipped with an intuitive top-mounted touch sensor button, players can effortlessly switch between multiple dynamic lighting profiles—including smooth rainbow waves, breathing color cycles, static color themes, or audio-synced music reaction modes.

 The dynamic music mode pulses in real-time rhythm with in-game explosions, music beats, and sound effects, creating an immersive visual spectrum on your desk. When focusing on work or watching movies in the dark, a simple tap on the touch sensor turns the lighting off entirely.

 
 Dual Dynamic Drivers & Enhanced Bass Radiator

 Clear Stereo Audio Performance for Gaming, Movies, and Music

 Inside the compact housing, the GS560 Adiemus is equipped with upgraded dual full-range 3W audio drivers paired with a central passive bass radiator. This acoustic configuration ensures clear stereo channel separation, delivering articulate dialogue, crisp treble detail, and surprisingly warm low-end resonance for a compact desktop speaker.

 Whether you are tracking ambient sound cues in casual open-world games, participating in voice calls, or enjoying your favorite music playlists, the Adiemus produces balanced, room-filling sound entirely free from distortion at high volume levels.

 
 Convenient Master Volume Knob & Power Switch

 Instant Tactile Sound Adjustments Right at Your Fingertips

 Never interrupt your focus to adjust software volume sliders or navigate operating system menus. The front panel of the Redragon GS560 Adiemus features a large, precision-tuned rotary volume knob illuminated with a subtle LED indicator ring.

 Combined with an integrated hardware power switch, turning the knob fully counter-clockwise clicks the soundbar completely off, while rotating it clockwise gives you smooth, fine-grained control over master audio levels on the fly.

PRESS RELEASE October 13, 2020 

 
 
 Apple introduces HomePod mini: A powerful smart speaker with amazing sound

 
 
 HomePod mini offers a great music listening experience, an intelligent assistant, and smart home capabilities, with built-in privacy and security, in a beautiful compact design

 
 
 
 

 
 HomePod mini, the newest addition to the HomePod family, stands at 3.3 inches tall and offers impressive sound, the intelligence of Siri, and smart home capabilities.

 

 
 
 
 Cupertino, California — Apple today unveiled HomePod mini, the newest addition to the HomePod family that delivers impressive sound, the intelligence of Siri to get things done, and a smart home experience that offers comfort and convenience without complexity. At just 3.3 inches tall, HomePod mini is packed with innovative technologies and advanced software that together enable computational audio to deliver breakthrough audio quality wherever it is placed. HomePod mini will be available in white and space gray at a great price of just $99.

 “HomePod mini has everything customers want in a smart speaker — amazing sound for listening to music, a world-class intelligent assistant that delivers a personal experience to each member of the household, and like every Apple product, it’s designed with privacy and security in mind,” said Bob Borchers, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Product Marketing. “HomePod mini is the ultimate smart speaker for anyone with an Apple device. It works effortlessly with iPhone to hand off music, answer calls, or deliver personalized listening suggestions, elevates the sound from Apple TV, plays music from a Mac, and so much more. There’s a lot of Apple innovation packed into such a small speaker, all at an affordable price.”

 
 
 
 

 
 HomePod mini uses the intelligence of Siri to deliver a personalized experience for each member of a household.

 

 
 
 
 HomePod mini is designed to work with Apple Music, podcasts, radio stations from iHeartRadio, radio.com, and TuneIn, and in the coming months, popular music services including Pandora and Amazon Music. Multiple HomePod mini speakers work together to stream music or podcasts to multiple rooms, all in perfect sync. By placing two HomePod mini speakers in a single room, a stereo pair can be created for a wide soundstage, filling the space with rich, enveloping sound.

 
 
 
 

 
 A touch surface right on top of HomePod mini lets users play, pause, skip a song, adjust the volume, or talk to Siri.

 

 
 
 
 Amazing Sound 

 HomePod mini delivers an incredibly rich and detailed acoustic experience, using computational audio to deliver peak performance. To achieve big sound out of such a compact design, the Apple S5 chip in HomePod mini works with advanced software to analyze the unique characteristics of the music and apply complex tuning models to optimize loudness, adjust the dynamic range, and control the movement of the driver and passive radiators in real time. The Apple-engineered full-range driver, powered by a neodymium magnet and a pair of force-cancelling passive radiators, enables deep bass and crisp high frequencies.

 Applying the same acoustic principles used to deliver amazing sound in HomePod, HomePod mini features an Apple-designed acoustic waveguide to direct the flow of sound down and out toward the bottom of the speaker for an immersive 360-degree audio experience. This allows customers to place HomePod mini almost anywhere in a room and hear consistent sound. A three-microphone array listens for “Hey Siri,” and a fourth inward-facing microphone helps isolate sound coming from the speaker to improve voice detection when music is playing.

 
 
 
 

 
 HomePod mini features custom hardware, including the Apple S5 chip, and advanced software to deliver breakthrough sound using computational audio.

 With the intelligence of Siri, HomePod mini delivers a personalized and deeply integrated experience for iPhone c
